hypothesis: W-R43's 89.35% paired-ranking gain depended on observing both original/altered candidates. When only one observed sequence is presented, self-generating all 14 adjacent tail-swap alternatives may yield useful anomaly evidence without the evaluator disclosing which site was actually swapped. Performance must be distinguished from a privileged known-site contrastive baseline.
freeze: Freeze dev seeds2224..2239, heldout2240..2255, same W-R43 paired-difference weights/32 epochs/1728 balanced pair-order development examples, 16-dimension lag2 features, 4-bit quantizer, identical synthetic generators/site10/12 and two codebooks. Holdout inference under blind arms sees only raw base and candidate, no true site, no alternate original, and fixed all 14 tail-adjacent swaps. Predetermined min-margin and majority-negative rules with score>0 per generated alternate, no threshold tuning.
arms: known_site_oracle: evaluator supplies true swap site to generate the exact counterpart; privileged benchmark only, not deployable
blind_any_better: scan all 14 adjacent tail swaps; predict candidate genuine iff NO generated variant has a strictly greater paired-difference score (margin<-1e-10)
blind_majority: scan all 14 swaps; candidate genuine iff fewer than seven generated variants have strictly greater relative score
metrics: For each candidate (balanced 864 originals and864 swapped counterfactuals per encoding) record TP/TN/FP/FN by seed/generator/site; 14 fixed counterfactual comparisons for each blind arm, one for oracle baseline; preserve identical alternatives and tie behavior, XOR feature equivalence assertions, runtime comparison counts.
classification: BLIND_CONTRASTIVE_GAIN iff either blind arm achieves >=0.65 balanced accuracy and within 0.10 of known-site privileged baseline under both encodings; PARTIAL_GAIN iff either achieves >=0.55 but strict criterion fails; NO_GAIN otherwise. Do not claim parity of compute or information across arms.
controls: Training source original W-R43 paired-difference scheme with NEW development seeds only, 1728 examples, 16 weights+bias, 32 fixed epochs; no sealed training or post-result site selection

Blind inference never receives true swap site, ground-truth original, or a second independently observed candidate. Only fixed local transforms of the same current candidate are allowed; known-site comparator explicitly leaks evaluator side information
Fixed 14 local transformations are a bounded additional inference-compute cost; not a learned recurrent state or generalized anomaly detection
Original immutable first-use evidence, one full Go regression/build and no accepted-ref/authority mutation
claim_limit: Deterministic synthetic alternate-generation diagnostic; any success is conditional on a known local-swap mechanism, not unsupervised open-world anomaly detection.
